title: VTC Boards — Show — payload
description: Show one board and its ideas as the caller may see them, with each accepted idea's election stage, ballot count where its board is public, and result once tallied — never who took a ticket or voted. The outer document members are owned by the framework — SPEC §6.3.

cursor.description: An opaque continuation token from a previous response's `nextCursor`, bound to the caller and the filters; a responder MUST NOT accept a cursor it did not issue.

limit.description: The most items to return, at most 200; the responder chooses a default (50) and MAY return fewer.

Response.title: VTC Boards — Show — response payload
Response.description: The success response to a vtc/boards/show/0.1 request. Carried in a Trust Task document whose type is https://trusttasks.org/spec/vtc/boards/show/0.1#response.

nextCursor.description: Continuation token for the next page; pass it back as `cursor`. Absent on the last page — never `null`.
